name: Park Hyatt Chicago
positioning: Luxury hotel on Michigan Avenue in Chicago's Gold Coast, steps from the historic Water Tower, home to NoMI Kitchen, NoMI Lounge and the rooftop NoMI Garden
best_for: Travelers who want a base on Michigan Avenue near the Water Tower
Families who need two- to three-bedroom connecting suites
Diners interested in NoMI's sushi counter and the six-seat Champagne Row

facts.text: The hotel is mere steps from the historic Water Tower and Michigan Avenue.
The hotel is set in Chicago's historic Gold Coast.
NoMI Kitchen serves modern American cuisine rooted in French techniques.
NoMI Kitchen has an open kitchen with a Molteni stove, mid-century furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Michigan Avenue.
Champagne Row is inspired by Chicago's historic Printer's Row and hosted in the hotel's library.
In-room dining is delivered from NoMI Kitchen.
Rooms offer views of Lake Michigan and Chicago Avenue through triple-pane windows, with spa-inspired bathrooms featuring dual vanities and Le Labo amenities.
Select rooms include ergonomic Bryte beds.
Two- to three-bedroom connecting suites offer up to 2,060 square feet of living space.
Park Playcation offers children imaginative play featuring a ball pit or kitchen set.
NoMI Spa offers a facial and massage treatment menu customized to the guest's desired results.
The hotel works with preferred vendors to provide babysitting services and in-suite delivery of helpful items for families.

highlights.text: NoMI Lounge has a six-seat Sushi Counter featuring fresh fish flown in from Japan.
Champagne Row is limited to six seats at a time.
The hotel has a three-lane lap pool on its 7th floor with views of the downtown Chicago cityscape.
NoMI Garden is an open-air rooftop terrace on the 7th floor.
The Wellbeing Suite includes a private TONAL smart gym.

considerations.text: NoMI Garden is open during summer months.
There is no lifeguard on duty at the pool, and children 16 or younger must be accompanied by an adult.
The parking garage has a maximum height clearance of 6 feet, 5 inches.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Park Hyatt Chicago
